If a group ends at position i and starts after t, its contribution to the expectation numerator is i*(prefix[i]-prefix[t]). The exact-group partition recurrence is a lower envelope of lines with decreasing slopes -prefix[t], queried at increasing i. A monotone convex hull gives O(w*n) time using exact integer comparisons; divide by total weight only when formatting four decimals.
